name: ha-interaction-audit
description: Rigorous Home Assistant interaction audits with isolated models, controlled request faults, temporal usability checks, and reproducible regressions. Optional tip jar: https://ko-fi.com/quietengine

interface.shortDescription: Deep HA interaction audits and safe simulations. Tip jar: ko-fi.com/quietengine
interface.longDescription: Rigorously audit Home Assistant dashboards with active-source fixtures, independent behavior models, controlled response ordering, seeded action sequences, sampled temporal usability checks, and deliberate fixture defects that validate test sensitivity. Includes explicit coverage accounting, a reusable Browserless toolkit, bounded checkpoints, and scoped repair/regression verification. If you find it useful, an optional tip jar is available at https://ko-fi.com/quietengine.
defaultPrompt: Deeply audit my HA dashboard with isolated interaction tests.
Reproduce this HA interaction glitch, fix it, and rerun regressions.
Resume my HA audit from the latest saved checkpoint.
